answer: Proof of replication. A storage agent serving velvet texture samples, umber pigment scans, or dune imagery commits to an account-specific encoding of the archive. Unpredictable audits request authenticated blocks under a deadline too short to rebuild a missing replica. N rewarded accounts must retain N distinct encodings, paying N storage costs; copying an account name adds no capacity. This assumes the encoding resists compression and fast regeneration, and audits catch deletion before rewards are released.
